title: runtime: the stored-metadata reader seam still reads an in-process `searchFields: []` as "names none" and serves the narrowed default set
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Filing gate: ① contract review of PR #28108 (#27732), should-fix S1 (record 6523659371), from the dev's out-of-scope finding (os-dev report 6523412292). Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: an in-process host handler (sandboxed body, flow, hook) that searches a stored-metadata object with `searchFields: []`. REST callers are refused first by `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`, so no wire caller sees it.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/runtime`, with the helper in `packages/metadata-protocol`).

## What the code does (read, not measured)

After PR #28108 the engine refuses an empty `searchFields` override (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, the door's envelope). One layer above it, `refuseOrNarrowStoredMetadataEvaluate` (`packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts` ~L151-154) calls `narrowStoredMetadataSearch` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` ~L5194). Its explicit-list derivation reads `[]` as `names.length === 0`, takes the "names none → narrow to the allowed set" branch and writes the narrowed default set back onto the query. So on that object family the empty override reaches the engine non-empty and is served, unrefused. The docblock at `protocol.ts` ~L5185-5187 ("an empty override is ABSENT to the engine, which would then scan the whole default set") is false once #28108 lands.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

The seam refuses an empty override the way the engine and the door do (or passes it through so the engine refuses it), and the docblock says what is true. Expected `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `searchFields`, `stored-metadata reader`, `narrowStoredMetadataSearch`, empty override: none. **New.**

Links back: #27732, PR #28108, #28059
